name: Cá mú
summary: Cá mú is sold by weight at the floating kitchens on vịnh Cảng Cá, the old fish-port bay in town. The working fish port moved to cảng cá Trân Châu on 10 November 2021.
where: Vịnh Cảng Cá, Cát Bà town.
